text.p: Cleanup continues along the Red River in the upper Plains of the USA and in southern Manitoba, Canada, near Winnepeg. The next chance for moderate rain in the area does not come until late in the week. Rainfall so far this month has averaged below normal.

Tropical cyclone 36s (Rhonda) is a significant risk to shipping in the southeast Indian Ocean. Top winds have reached 110 mph in the latest report with the system near 16s/96e. It will reach peak intensity over the next 24 hours before beginning a slow weakening trend. The system will remain over open waters of the southern Indian Ocean, threatening shipping.
There are no further statements at this time.
